title: Launch a VC fund
summary: The vehicle formed and filed, the LPs signed and closed, the money loop running.

parts.title: Form a VC fund
parts.guidance: Define the proposed fund strategy, investor profile, manager structure and relevant jurisdictions before engaging the formation workflow. Coordinate counsel and tax advisers around the actual vehicle and fundraising model. Retain approved formation and governing records with unresolved regulatory work explicit, so investor onboarding starts from the structure actually established.

parts.title: Close the fund
parts.guidance: Run each closing against the fund's governing documents, investor approvals and current subscription requirements. Use the closing workflow to reconcile signatures, commitments, admission conditions and required funding. Track prospective commitments, signed subscriptions and completed admissions separately, with the closing records supporting each admitted investor.

parts.title: Run the fund back office
parts.guidance: Run fund administration from the fund and management-entity structure, signed commitments and governing agreements. Coordinate capital calls, receipt reconciliation, management fees and investment entries with the administrator. Assign the recurring work among the GP, administrator and advisers, using the transaction records to explain investor balances and communications.
